name: Solaz
insider_take: Where desert luxury meets dramatic coastline – Solaz is perched on the edge of the Pacific with unobstructed views of the iconic Land's End rock formations.
whats_special: This architectural marvel features infinity pools that seem to spill directly into the Pacific Ocean, while its location on the Corridor offers front-row seats to migrating whales (December-April). The resort's distinctive angular design mirrors the surrounding desert landscape, and it's one of the few properties where you can witness both sunrise and sunset over water from different vantage points.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors facing northwest for the best views of the famous Arch of Cabo San Lucas, especially magical during golden hour when the granite formations glow amber.
dont_miss: The rooftop Sky Pool offers 360-degree views of Land's End, while the resort sits just minutes from the only swimmable beach in Cabo - Medano Beach. Take advantage of the resort's prime whale-watching location during winter months, when humpback and gray whales pass directly in front of the property.
pros: Stunning contemporary design with dramatic ocean views
Multiple infinity pools cascading toward the Sea of Cortez
Exceptional dining venues including rooftop restaurants
Prime Cabo location near marina and downtown attractions
